import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def add_engine_headers(request, call_next):
    response = await call_next(request)
    ephemeris_value = "default"
    if request.url.path.startswith("/v4/api/future-bs"):
        try:
            from app.research.solar_ingress_engine import active_ephemeris_label

            if active_ephemeris_label() == "jpl_de440":
                ephemeris_value = "jpl-de440-lahiri-sidereal"
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("Unable to resolve active ephemeris label: %s", exc)
    response.headers["X-Parva-Ephemeris"] = ephemeris_value
    return response
